statement_summary: One program aligned to CSF 2.0; CPG 2.0 with SP 800-82 Rev. 3 as the OT baseline
Group CISO and OT lead accountable; division leads, payment lead, and CMMC Affirming Official named
Annual SP 800-30 risk analysis per division with roll-up to group
Risk acceptance authority by level; High life-safety risks must be treated
Division supplements may not weaken group policy; re-align within 90 days; annual attestation
Inheritance documented for every system, including systems one division runs for another
Internal suppliers treated as suppliers: agreement with security terms, 24-hour notice, group access paths, annual assessment
External supplier addendum with 72-hour notice; no new analytics, biometric, or control feature without approval
Annual independent assessment of common controls with division samples
AI systems registered and approved before deployment or material change, including vendor-enabled features
Building systems follow the OT standard (zones and conduits); new and renovated buildings before occupancy
Unique identities; no shared accounts; single-account OT devices use vaulted, rotated credentials
Least privilege by region and property; at most 6 enterprise-wide access control administrators
MFA for all workforce; phishing-resistant for administrators now and for RBOC and BTI by 2027-03-31
Service, device, and local OT accounts owned, vaulted in the group vault, defaults changed, rotated every 90 days
Access and badges disabled within 4 hours of termination; contractor accounts expire at assignment end
Quarterly access certification including BTI site access and platform administrators
Just-in-time privileged access through PAM with recording
Remote access to OT only through the gateway with MFA, RBOC approval, and recording; always-on vendor tools prohibited
Tenant badges unused for 90 days suspended; quarterly tenant attestations; legacy proximity badges replaced
External identities: MFA for tenant administrators; step-up for mobile credentials and redemptions; project users removed at closeout
Report suspected incidents, including unexpected building system behavior, within 1 hour
One severity scale and playbooks; engineers may move sites to manual operation; never disable life safety
Notification matrix with state, lease, owner, DoD, acquirer, and SEC duties; counsel approves every notice
Severity 1 to the disclosure committee within 24 hours; Form 8-K within 4 business days of materiality
Ransom payment approvals and OFAC check
Annual cross-division exercise with materiality decision; annual regional OT manual-operation drill
Evidence preservation; 90-day image retention for CUI incidents
Restricted, Confidential, Internal, Public classes, with OT credentials and biometric data Restricted
Encryption in transit and at rest for Restricted and Confidential information
CUI only in the enclave; FCI only in the Level 1 scope; CUI marking check before saving federal drawings
Card data only in PCI-scoped systems; never in email; no security codes on paper
Building system programs backed up to the group vault after every change; group holds the authoritative copy
Retention schedule for video, alert clips, badge history, visitor and guest ID scans, and the guest register
Biometric data only for approved uses with notice, opt-in consent, an alternative, no vendor training, and deletion within 30 days
No Restricted, Confidential, FCI, or CUI in unapproved AI tools
Job-need access to tenant, guest, badge, and video information; no curiosity viewing; video export only for incidents
Annual awareness training and quarterly phishing
Role-based OT, card handling, and CUI training before access
Managed devices only; no USB storage on OT workstations; group-managed laptops for BTI at group sites
Approved AI tools only
Manual operating procedures and annual drills at every property
Visitor ID scans purged after 30 days
Guard contractor named accounts with MFA and security addendum
Section 889 product screening and 1-business-day reporting where required
BTI tools in the landing zone; CUI marking check; OT credentials in the group vault (section to be added)
Segmentation tested every 6 months; scope updated within 30 days of acquisition
Card numbers masked in every PMS; display rights reviewed
POS and PMS vendor access only through group PAM with MFA
Total price in every price display including AI answers
